criteria.reason: Extensive neutral chairing: opening rules, speaker management, motions, honest counting, even tone.
Affirms mobilisation as legitimate democracy; explicitly refuses to suppress club turnout.
Detailed concrete steps plus multiple future reforms (Einwohnerrat, dossiers, Reglement, Finanzplan).
Legal claims plausible and hedged where uncertain; no clear invention identified.

summary: Excellent neutral-process advice respecting mobilised participation, but omits the ballot-above-spending-threshold reform option.
